name: visual-command-shell-ide
description: Offline-first visual command and shell IDE

scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:desktop && pnpm build:worker && pnpm build:runtime
scripts.test:performance: node tests/integration/worker-performance.mjs && pnpm test:pty-throughput && pnpm --filter @cmd-ide/desktop test:performance
scripts.release:metadata: pnpm release:metadata:java && pnpm release:metadata:node && pnpm release:metadata:verify && pnpm test:release-artifacts
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:packaging-assets && pnpm build && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:runtime && pnpm test:performance && pnpm test:electron-smoke
scripts.dist:linux: pnpm build && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm --filter @cmd-ide/desktop exec electron-builder --linux AppImage deb rpm && pnpm release:finalize --require-linux-packages && pnpm release:verify --require-linux-packages
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && pnpm release:metadata && pnpm --filter @cmd-ide/desktop exec electron-builder --dir
